Why Rohi

An education that forms the whole child

Academics, character and confidence — developed together, not traded off.

Strong academics

A rigorous curriculum from Kindergarten through Senior Secondary, with continuous assessment and CBT examinations.

Character first

Punctuality, honesty and respect are taught and assessed termly alongside every academic subject.

Practical skills

Vocational practicals sit beside academic theory, so students leave able to do as well as to know.

Close community

Small classes and an open-door staff room mean no child moves through unnoticed.
